senses.definition: An exploit in which the VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) source code in a document is removed or replaced, but the compiled p-code is left intact. Since in some cases only the source code is checked for malware, this can allow malicious code to go undetected.
A vaginal birth undertaken with precautionary measures subsequent to a cesarean section birth.
senses.example: I was worried about having a VBAC because my mother nearly bled to death when she gave live birth to me after having had a cesarean.

senses.definition: A programmer who uses the Visual Basic language.
senses.example: VBers may find the syntax of C# a bit unpalatable.

senses.definition: A scripting language that is a subset of Microsoft Visual Basic.
